text:
Ana Morales: Quick asset request for the benchmark webinar + launch posts. Need: hero comparison tile (p95 latency vs cost), two 1:1 social tiles (carousel + CTA), and a webinar slide master with a routed CTA. Brand + accessibility required. First drafts by Wed EOD.
Lina Chen: On it. Confirm metrics to surface: p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost/token?
Mike Patel: Yes. Use p95, tokens/sec, cost/token. Sample labels: Hosted p95=320ms / 150 t/s / $0.0009; Dedicated p95=180ms / 420 t/s / $0.0006; Private p95=210ms / 380 t/s / $0.0005. Hosted as baseline.
Kate Rivera: Brand constraints: Approved Blue #0A6CF0 accent, follow logo clearspace, AA contrast minimum. Provide SVG logos + flattened PNGs. No decorative gradients over logo area.
Lina Chen: Design Qs: hero viz bars or sparkline? Also micro-infographic for cache+batching?
Ana Morales: Bars for hero. Include a 1:1 micro-infographic that reads "cache + batching = lower unit cost" (illustrative). Keep copy short.
Design-Bot: Figma starter: https://figma.com/file/REDACTED/bench-mini-pack. Export presets: hero 1200x630 PNG @2x (max 1.5MB), micro 1080x1080 PNG, slide 1920x1080 PNG + PDF master. Include alt text frame.
Jordan Lee: Routing: slide CTA should tag leads with "bench_webinar_2026" and utm_campaign=bench_launch. Ill update routing doc once assets are live. Provide CSV mapping CTA->tag.
Mike Patel: Add a small code snippet box on the slide (300x150px) for "sample query latency". Lina please reserve that area and add dark-mode variant.
Kate Rivera: Accessibility reminder: validate color of cost-delta badge (green) for contrast; provide mono patterned fallback for print. Use accessible icon strokes.
Lina Chen: Timeline: first frames by Tue EOB, internal review Wed, final exports Thurs noon. Posting frames here when ready.
Ana Morales: Marketing will QA messaging; design handles visual QC. Tag Jordan & Kate when final exports live. Thanks! :art::rocket:
